contentPattern: Row 1, 1 cell: eyebrow paragraph(s) before the statement heading (h2), statement h2, optional italic-only source paragraph ('*Source: U.S. Census Bureau*'). Then 1 row per answer, 2-3 cells: answer label ('True' / 'False', authored - not hard-coded) | feedback shown when that answer is chosen (e.g. h3 'That's correct!' or 'Not quite.') | optional 3rd cell, any text (e.g. 'correct') marks the correct answer. Optional last row, 1 cell: explanation shown after any answer (paragraphs, CTA link). Answering locks the buttons (aria-pressed on the chosen one), reveals the result in an aria-live region and moves focus to it. Nothing is fetched.
